=== CARE HOSPITALS URL-PATTERN FINDING (applies to the ~330 remaining CARE rows) ===
(a) YES - carehospitals.com publishes genuine per-doctor profile pages. Confirmed by an indexed live example for this doctor.
(b) EXACT PATTERN OBSERVED: https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor/<city>/<branch-slug>/<doctor-name-slug>-<specialty-slug> , e.g. .../doctor/hyderabad/banjara-hills/a-s-v-narayana-rao-interventional-cardiologist . Note the doctor slug has NO 'dr-' prefix and the specialty is appended to the name in the SAME path segment. A second, branch-less variant also exists in cities with a single campus: https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor/visakhapatnam/metta-jayachandra-reddy-surgical-oncologist (city, then name-specialty, no branch segment).
(c) YES - for Hyderabad the pattern ENCODES THE BRANCH as its own path segment ('banjara-hills'). Separately, the branch-scoped LIST pages use a different and more verbose branch slug: https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor-list/hyderabad/care-hospital-banjara-hills/... and https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor-list/hyderabad/care-hospital-hi-tech-city/... (note 'care-hospital-banjara-hills' and 'care-hospital-hi-tech-city' on /doctor-list/, versus the bare 'banjara-hills' on /doctor/). Useful list endpoints seen: /doctor-list/hyderabad/<branch>, /doctor-list/hyderabad/<branch>/coe/<centre-of-excellence>, /doctor-list/hyderabad/<branch>/speciality/<speciality>. There is also a CARE Outpatient Centre Banjara Hills as a SEPARATE branch ('care-outpatient-centre-banjara-hills') - do not confuse it with the main Banjara Hills hospital. IMPORTANT for later agents: knowing the pattern does NOT license constructing these URLs; per-doctor pages must still be seen verbatim in a search result (see row 416, where the doctor is on CARE list pages but no per-doctor page is indexed).
